scope: proposal/discovery/prepare and ordinary CLI safety boundaries

findings.disposition: Fixed with post-response cancellation checks; two new red/green tests; 16 proposal tests and full regression pass

findings.finding: Provider has no AbortSignal propagation; inflight cancellation waits for bounded return/timeout
findings.disposition: Known lifecycle limit; returned usage retained, no further dispatch or publication

findings.finding: Legacy read with both path and contradictory selector may yield file-unavailable
findings.disposition: Legacy API edge; new strict provider contract only accepts selector

findings.finding: Contained overlapping windows can consume duplicate display budget
findings.disposition: Actual repeated source is charged; remains lexical-index quality limit
